facts.claim: A light-year is the distance light travels in a year, about 9 trillion km.

source.title: NASA Space Place: What is a light-year?

facts.claim: Distant objects are seen as they were in the past; some stars we see are thousands of light-years away.

source.title: NASA Space Place: What is a light-year?
source.quote: When we use powerful telescopes to look at distant objects in space, we are actually looking back in time. … The farther an object is, the farther in the past we see it. … All of the other stars we can see with our eyes are farther, some even thousands of light-years away.
